instructions: Short original AI-authored practice; not an official or teacher paper. Self-mark using the guidance after submission.
description: Three original questions with self-marking guidance.

questions.text: What is the purpose of a protocol?

answer.text: A set of agreed rules governing communication between devices.

questions.text: What is the difference between serial and parallel transmission?

answer.text: Serial sends bits one after another on a channel; parallel sends multiple bits simultaneously on separate channels.
The maximum data transfer capacity of a communication channel per unit time.
